_comment: Copy this file to tests/.owner-terms.json and replace the terms with the
strings that must never appear in this repo: your own name and handles,
the names of people, pets and places in your photos, your drive and
vault paths, anything else that identifies you. That file is gitignored;
this example is committed and must stay fake.
tests/no_owner_facts.py loads it, matches case-insensitively, and reports
only WHERE a term was found — never which term, and never the line.
